annotations.title: Store a field report (Camp Map Pass)

description: Stores a one-tap field report at a point, the same kind the map's users leave (kinds: road-good, road-rough, road-4x4, washout, gate-open, gate-locked, spot-ok, spot-closed, no-camping, hauling, turnaround, no-turnaround, rig-ok, low-clearance; vehicle: car, awd, 4x4, van, rv, unk). Needs the user's Camp Map Pass key; at most 10 stored reports a day per key. No free text.
